reviews.review_title: Good but can be very good.
reviews.review_description: Really cool game. I like wave shooters like this. Just jump in then action. Easy controls. Graphics are very nice. The sound and music keeps you locked in. The biggest gripe was the controls kept switching and i couldn't determine my direction consistently. One minute during the heat of battle, I can go forward  then all of a sudden I'm going the opposite direction. Hopefully this will be fixed soon and more content added in future.

developer_response.body: Thanks for your great review! The controls are under review and we will certainly look at offering alternatives in the settings so you can choose which you prefer.

reviews.review_description:
Another space-themed arena wave shooter. This is essentially a demo, with a limited # of waves currently available, and the full version (campaign?) Abd endless mode available for purchase. The graphics are pretty good, as are the crash animations for the ships. I didn't see any aliens - maybe I didn't get that far? It was hard to tell if I was killed or if I reached the end of the game. It just abruptly ended. The guns feel pretty good, but more variety would be nice. My only major gripes so far are 1) The arena/play area is very small, and 2) the locomotion controls are very odd. On the left stick, up brings you toward one end of the arena and down brings you toward the other, regardless of the direction you're facing. That needs to change. 

Otherwise, it's pretty cool. I'm curious to see where it goes.

developer_response.body: Thanks for your review! The free version of the game has 10 levels after which you go straight to the purchase screen. I agree this is a bit abrupt and we'll make it clearer what's happening here in an update. You don't actually die btw. We currently have 4 different weapons in the game which appear in the later levels as the action gets a lot more intense (the video showcase is from about level 60). The initial Campaign will be coming in the next week or two but this will be ongoing with many parts in the future. Stay tuned and thanks again for your review.

reviews.review_description:
It's ok for a demo, I purchased the full game and No the campaign mode is not there, it says coming in July. 
Infinite ammo I think? no reloading weapons. I do like the zoom on the weapon, it's a little magnifying glass that pops up as a sight onto of the riffle. Only seen 2 weapons so far. 

Looks nice enough, doesn't really have proper locomotion controls so can be getting motion sickness if you run around.
I only saw ships to shoot in arcade mode, then at the end a few bugs from  shooting down what looks like the the boss level ship? 
Unfortunately died instantly. 
Guns pods drop from the sky idk if you have to shoot them down? But standing next to them seems to collect from them.. Not seen any health pods so far. 

Tbh just starting arcade mode over and over is not keeping my Interest at all.
Might check back when there is a campaign mode

developer_response.body: Thanks for your review! Campaign mode is coming in the next week or two so stay tuned. This will have a number of missions initially but will be ongoing with future updates. The pistols you start with recharge over time but there are ammo drops to reload these and other weapons you get in later levels. You don't shoot them down but collect from them when they land. You didn't actually die btw, the demo version has 10 levels after which you need to buy the game. I appreciate the transition could be better and this will be improved in an update. We'll take another look at those controls. You can adjust the rotation in the pause screen (left menu button).You don't have to keep replaying the levels btw. if you bought the game. If it looks like you're going to die, just hit the left menu button to save out your position in the pause menu and you can continue playing later from the start of the level you were on. Thanks again for your purchase and hope you stick around!
